headline: DRC BANS ALL COBALT EXPORTS FROM NOVEMBER 30 — Four-Month Suspension Targets Glut; Chinese Processors Surge 14% as Battery Makers Face Second Supply Shock in Two Years
snippet: Congo's mining regulator ARECOMS has announced a suspension of all cobalt exports effective November 30 — the second blanket ban in two years — aimed at addressing a severe price glut. Benchmark Mineral Intelligence characterizes it as a four-month halt. Chinese cobalt processors surged up to 14% on the news while Western EV battery makers face fresh supply-chain disruption.

headline: LYNAS SURGES 7% ON RECORD NdPr OUTPUT — 2,082 Tonnes Q1 FY27 Sets Production High as Rare Earth Stocks Bifurcate Between Profitable and Speculative
snippet: Lynas Rare Earths (ASX: LYC) surged 7% to A$13.70 as markets rewarded its Q1 FY27 production record of 2,082 tonnes NdPr at a realized price of A$102.1/kg. Floor-price agreements covering over 50% of output provide revenue stability that most rare earth peers lack. The move highlights a growing divide between profitable integrated producers and U.S.-listed names that have cratered this month.

headline: ORA BANDA DRILLING OPENS NEW 4.5KM GOLD TREND AT ROUND DAM — 11m AT 12.1 G/T BELOW EXISTING RESOURCE; SHARES JUMP 8%
snippet: Ora Banda Mining (ASX: OBM) surged 8% after drilling below the Round Dam resource in Western Australia returned 11m at 12.1 g/t gold and uncovered a new parallel trend roughly 400m east of the existing deposit, stretching 4.5km. The result comes from a A$75M FY27 exploration budget targeting system-scale growth at Davyhurst near Kalgoorlie.

headline: GENESIS MINERALS AND VAULT COMPLETE A$12.6B MERGER — Australia's Second-Largest Gold Producer Formed With Target of 700,000 oz Annual Output
snippet: The Genesis Minerals (ASX: GMD) and Vault Minerals (ASX: VAU) scheme of arrangement implements November 26, following court effectiveness on November 17. Vault shareholders receive 0.7629 Genesis shares plus A$0.475 cash per share in a deal valued at A$12.6 billion, creating a combined Western Australian gold producer targeting 600,000–700,000 oz annually — Australia's second-largest behind Newmont's local operations.

headline: QMINES DRILLS 46.8m AT 2.29% COPPER AND 1.03 G/T GOLD BELOW OLD QUEENSLAND PIT — Mt Chalmers Infill Hits Below Ore Reserve Grade
snippet: QMines (ASX: QML) drilled 46.8m averaging 2.29% copper and 1.03 g/t gold in infill drilling below the existing Ore Reserve at its historic Mt Chalmers VMS project near Rockhampton, Queensland. The result — drilled under the footprint of the old open pit — adds to a 9.6Mt Ore Reserve and supports the pre-feasibility phase ahead of a planned restart.

headline: BRIXTON METALS HITS 158m AT 0.25% CuEq AT CATALYST AND DISCOVERS COPPER AT SENTINEL — Two Targets Confirmed at Thorn Project BC in Same Season
snippet: Brixton Metals (TSX-V: BBB) reported that every hole from the Catalyst discovery pad at Thorn (northwest BC) intersected broad copper-gold-molybdenum mineralization, with the best hole returning 158m at 0.25% CuEq from 9m depth. Maiden drilling at the nearby Sentinel target also confirmed copper mineralization for the first time, expanding the footprint of this large-scale porphyry system.

headline: EVERGOLD DRILLS 75.9m AT 1.29 G/T AuEq AT GOLDEN LION — Broadest 2026 Interval Completes Northern Fence; 10 Holes Still Pending
snippet: Evergold Corp (TSX-V: EVER) reported 75.9m at 1.29 g/t gold equivalent from the final northern hole at its GL1 Zone at Golden Lion in BC's Toodoggone district — the program's broadest interval to date. The result builds on earlier holes including 28m at 10.4 g/t gold within a 113m interval of 5.4 g/t, with 10 of 16 total 2026 holes remaining to be reported.

headline: PINNACLE SILVER & GOLD PINOS CUATES FINAL ASSAYS: 8.10 G/T GOLD OVER 4.39m IN MEXICO UNDERGROUND — Down-Dip Continuity Confirmed Below Mined Areas
snippet: Pinnacle Silver and Gold (TSX-V: PINN) released final underground delineation results from its Pinos Cuates mine in Durango, Mexico, with highlight intervals including 8.10 g/t gold and 62 g/t silver over 4.39 metres true width. Results confirm down-dip continuity of mineralization below previously mined areas and support the company's underground development plan.

headline: BUY AGNICO EAGLE AND FRANCO-NEVADA BEFORE 2026 ENDS — Motley Fool Argues Both Survive Any Market Crash With Safe Dividends and Financial Strength
snippet: With gold miners down 29–49% over three months despite earnings holding up, a Motley Fool analysis on November 26 singles out Agnico Eagle (AEM) and Franco-Nevada (FNV) as the two gold names most likely to survive further market turbulence — citing low debt, geographic diversification, and stable dividend policies built for lower gold prices. The case rests on financial resilience rather than a near-term price catalyst.

headline: AFRICA FOLLOWS CHINA'S LEAD: COBALT BAN IGNITES WAVE OF MINERAL EXPORT CONTROLS ACROSS CONTINENT — DRC Move Marks Structural Shift in Critical Mineral Geopolitics
snippet: An analysis in bne IntelliNews argues that the DRC's latest cobalt export suspension signals a broader continental shift: African resource states are systematically adopting China's export-control model to capture more commodity value at home. Western supply-chain planners face a qualitatively new threat as the continent's largest producers of cobalt, copper, lithium, and rare earths align incentives against raw mineral exports.
